consequence.statement: A new metric is available. The evidence says nothing that existing configuration has to change.

original.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds a new metric, cilium_node_health_connectivity_status, listed under the upgrade notes' Added Metrics section.

decision.reason: [ev-b598b51801ea] lists `cilium_node_health_connectivity_status` only under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Added Metrics", next to other new metrics ([ev-34619549fb8a] and the rest). Nothing in the section says anything fails, is rejected, stops working or needs migrating. A newly available metric needs no action from the operator, so the consequence is "none" (informational).
